title: Frequency 4.16
description: Two night operators share a dead frequency and one decision.

dialogue.speaker: Static
dialogue.text: Three in the morning. The band has been empty for hours — then, under the static, a third signal. Faint. Repeating.

dialogue.speaker: Static
dialogue.text: It is not addressed to anyone. It is just asking if anyone is there. Key your answer.

dialogue.speaker: Static
dialogue.text: Two stations key at once — a chord where there should be a note.

dialogue.speaker: Static
dialogue.text: The faint signal stops repeating. Then, slowly, it sends: THANK YOU. NOT ALONE. NEITHER ARE YOU.

dialogue.speaker: Static
dialogue.text: You both hold the key open and silent, two people listening to the same ghost.

dialogue.speaker: Static
dialogue.text: At dawn the signal fades on its own. The frequency keeps your secret.
